اخضوضبا (form XII)
# اِخْضَوْضَبَا (iḵḍawḍabā) /ix.dˤaw.dˤa.baː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِخْضَوْضَبَ (iḵḍawḍaba)
# اِخْضَوْضِبَا (iḵḍawḍibā) /ix.dˤaw.dˤi.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِخْضَوْضَبَ (iḵḍawḍaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
